scope: Source-only private-failure diagnostics delta and local controls. No production qualification, active-run replacement or historical-failure diagnosis.
verified: Constructor, preflight, current, metadata-refresh and finish exceptions retain private type/text/traceback records; nested propagation reuses the original audit reference and never returns authority.

Audited exact comparisons retain equality semantics while recording expected/actual values, hashes and bounded changed paths. Source-binding disagreement still stops before the later preflight snapshot; final current input checks retain their original order.

Failure directories validate root ownership and private permissions; each new parent entry is fsynced, and receipt files use exclusive no-follow creation, private mode, file fsync and directory fsync.
Raw exception details and comparison values stay in private files. Console summaries expose bounded codes and audit references; the private synthetic secret fixture does not print its value.
Audit-write failures refuse authority. No retry is introduced by diagnostics; only the previously reviewed explicit final-query churn exception can trigger the bounded kernel re-observation loop.
Native, financial, READ, actor, private-file, mount, directory, boot and final source-fence guards remain mandatory. Earlier actual failures remain unexplained by this source review.
